title: How do we want to be described?
slide_intent: Give designers a way to translate desired audience impressions into concrete reference images.
strategic_value: Voltera can use four agreed impressions to evaluate design choices against its stated ambitions for the brand.
demonstration: The text attributes the goals to 2025 interviews. Four images and captions associate quality, reliability, premium design and delight with distinct visual references.
practical_value: Select an image or message by identifying which of the four impressions it supports and how.
